notes:
Summary: Conversync is a mid-market contact center automation vendor (chat-first) evaluating Redwood for high-volume cost-efficient deflection. They process large live chat volumes for multiple telco and retail customers and need predictable unit economics when scaling.

Key requirements / quotes:
- Primary objective: push 50-70% of incoming chats to automated flows (deflection) while keeping per-session cost sub-$0.05 and latency for suggestions <250ms.
- "We need to know what a 10k concurrent spike costs us — not just average TCO." — Head of Ops.
- Must support prefix/KV caching across sessions to avoid repeated prompt cost; prefer batching that keeps latency within SLA.
- Quantization welcome: interested in 4-bit/INT8 tradeoffs; ask for quality regressions matrix and sample outputs.
- Routing: prefer policy to route priority customers to higher-capacity model but fallback to smaller quantized variant on overload.
- Security: SSO/SAML, audit logs, KMS integration for keys, and EU data residency per contract.
- Deployment: start with Dedicated (VPC) POC; long-term may move to private on-prem for regulated telco customers.

POC ask + metrics to validate:
- 2-week Dedicated POC in us-east with autoscaling and canary routing enabled.
- Run synthetic traffic: baseline 5k concurrent chat windows, then 15k spike for 10 minutes — measure latency P95/P99, effective tokens per deflected session, and cost per deflected session.
- Compare unquantized vs 4-bit quantized model: quality samples for 100 prompts and regression threshold <=2% for NLU label accuracy.
- Instrument per-route token cost, caching hit rate, batching efficiency, and fallback events.

Linked artifacts: pricing deck + security FAQ in Drive; Fireflies for discovery and demo. Gmail thread holds legal/POC budget discussion. Jira ticket SUP-3421 created for infra limits observed in early tests.

Next steps (short):
- Provide POC pricing + SLA doc (AE), include detailed unit economics: tokens/session, projected monthly bill for 250k deflected sessions.
- SE to produce quantization quality matrix and recommended batching settings for 100–500ms latency target.
- Schedule legal/data residency call with security.
